description:
Bicep module templates used by DEVDEER.

This package is mainly for internal usage at DEVDEER. However most of the conventions are related to the suggestions in the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).

We also tried to provide much freedom by parametrize our modules a lot.
releaseNotes:
- BREAKING: Subnet delegations now don't expose id and type anymore and the allowed delegation types are selectable strings.
- Component: Azure Web App
- All properties the web app module supports are now also supported by the component.
- Module Azure Web App
- Support for running from public container repository by setting azureContainerRegistryName to null or empty but defining container image and version and set runContainer to true.
- Added support for defining new parameter azureStorageMappings which gets converted to path mapping pointing to Azure Storage account directories.
- Fixed resolution of deploy slot condition.
- Automatical setting of environment variables APPLICATIONINSIGHTSAGENT_EXTENSION_VERSION and XDT_MICROSOFTAPPLICATIONINSIGHTS_MODE.
- New module for MySQL flex servers added.
title: DEVDEER Bicep Modules
